title: HostFactory getAvailableTemplates response
$comment: Pins what hf-gce emits today. Spec: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/spectrum-symphony/7.3.2?topic=specification-getavailabletemplates. Differences from the spec are noted inline.

attributes.$comment: Not constrained. The spec requires type, ncores, ncpus and nram. The hf-gce templates have no ncores.

items.$comment: The spec allows provider-specific attributes. hf-gce adds gcp_zone and gcp_instance_group.
